changelog.notes: PVS mother trial exported as companion data to the India tricot trials, in the layout of release schema v2.0. PVS trials have no rankings.

study.title: Bread wheat PVS mother trial in Muzaffarpur (Bihar), rabi 2013-14
study.description: Participatory varietal selection (PVS) mother trial of bread wheat in Muzaffarpur (Bihar), rabi 2013-14 season. Researcher-managed plots on host farms, one plot per variety, with measured agronomic traits and yield and no farmer rankings. Published as companion data to the tricot trials of the same crop, season and district.

companion_of.link: same crop and season; shared district (adm2): Muzaffarpur

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites linked to a tricot site reuse that site's published point. Sites without GPS take the mean of tricot farms in the same district and village before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised
location_privacy.gap_filling: Sites without a point take the mean of located sites with the same administrative names, pooled across all published trials (adm2+adm3, then adm3, then adm2, within 30 km of their mean), before rounding. coordinate_source names the level, coordinate_uncertainty_m adds the spread of the pool.

genotypes.biotic_resistance: Greater stability against all the three rusts and more especially against leaf rust and leaf blight
It carries different APR Lr13 gene that will act as buffer against leaf rust.

genotypes.biotic_resistance: It possesses very high adult plant resistance against most prevalent leaf rust disease as well as of 78S84 and 46S119 two most virulent races of yellow rust disease. It has also better degree of resistance against leaf blight
The variety possesses the usable and most practical type of disease resistance viz., the adult plant resistance (APR) because of Lr13
genotypes.remarks: Average seed yield is 35-40 q/ ha

genotypes.recommended_zone: late sown conditions of north eastern Plains Zone
genotypes.biotic_resistance: High resistance to stripe, stem and leaf rusts. It has seedling resistance to almost all the pathotypes of the three rusts; and adult plant resistance to virulent stripe rust. It has good levels of resistance to leaf blight, powdery mildew and foot rot
genotypes.remarks: HI 1563 is a good quality wheat genotype with good bread, chapatti and biscuit quality with good levels of micronutrients like iron, zinc and copper

genotypes.recommended_zone: Eastern U.P., Bihar, Jharkhand, Orissa, Sikkim, West Bengal, Assam and plains of NE states
genotypes.biotic_resistance: Resistant to leaf rust, Kernel bunt and tolerant to leaf blight.

genotypes.biotic_resistance: High level of resistance to leaf rust, stem rust and leaf blight
